prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1188; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described in your file. The client was involved in a low-speed head-on collision and has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact the client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with any other coverage that may apply to this loss, including excess or umbrella coverage. Please also provide the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or event data recorder information, recorded statements, police materials in your possession, and any communications with the insured. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.
